# Third-party fixtures

Small, openly licensed library files from GitHub, used by `corpus_e2e.rs`.

| File | Source | Licence |
|------|--------|---------|
| `altium_pipe.SchLib` | https://github.com/embedded-society/altium-designer-mcp/blob/HEAD/scripts/samples/manual/pipe.SchLib | GPL-3.0 |
| `altium_pipe.PcbLib` | https://github.com/embedded-society/altium-designer-mcp/blob/HEAD/scripts/samples/manual/pipe.PcbLib | GPL-3.0 |

| `sparkfun_Battery.kicad_sym` | https://github.com/sparkfun/SparkFun-KiCad-Libraries/blob/HEAD/symbols/SparkFun-Battery.kicad_sym | CC-BY-4.0 |

The Altium files are synthetic files made by that project's writer, not by Altium itself. The Eagle `.lbr` fixture is `../eagle_r0603.lbr`.
